thread:
kevin-sales: FYI customer POC is failing when they flip to the Private Gateway. TLS handshakes keep timing out and their app reports DNS resolving to link-local addresses. Need swarming.
maria-solutions: Which customer / env? I can join a call.
kevin-sales: AcmeHealth, staging VPC -> our private endpoint (vpce-0abc). Happening from their onprem -> transit -> VPC. Error shows `tls: handshake failure` and browser shows cert chain mismatch.
alex-eng: Can you paste the client's curl / openssl output? Also, any NAT/firewall in front of the VPCE?
kevin-sales: Pasting logs from their dev team:

```
$ openssl s_client -connect vpce-0abc.redwood-internal:443 -servername models.redwood.ai
CONNECTED(00000003)
1397890:error:1408F10B:SSL routines:ssl3_get_record:wrong version number:../ssl/record/ssl3_record.c:332:
---
subject=/CN=redwood-internal
issuer=/C=US/O=Redwood/CN=Redwood Root CA
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
```

jordan-infra: That `wrong version number` usually means plaintext or proxy mangling TLS. Also the issuer looks internal — maybe they hit a proxy doing TLS inspection and presenting its own cert. Ask client to `curl -v --resolve` to use IP.
lisa-ps: They reported DNS A record for the endpoint on their resolver returns a 169.254.x.x address sometimes. Could be resolver policy or stale VPC endpoint mapping.
kevin-sales: Here's their `dig` output from their hop:

```
$ dig +short private-endpoint.acme.internal
169.254.169.123
```

alex-eng: 169.254 is link-local — indicates an internal shim or broken resolver when VPC resolver forwarding fails. Two quick checks:
- On client side: `nslookup private-endpoint.acme.internal` vs `dig @<company-resolver> private-endpoint.acme.internal` to confirm which resolver is answering.
- On our side: confirm Endpoint DNS entries in the private hosted zone and that route53 resolver rules are associated with the right VPCs.
maria-solutions: Also they're asking if this needs Dedicated capacity to avoid these private routing issues. What's the pricing delta if they go dedicated vs hosted for a private VPC endpoint?
kevin-sales: I told them we'd circle back after we confirm routing vs TLS. Please prep rough numbers for Dedicated monthly commit vs hosted egress usage.
jordan-infra: Quick infra notes:
- Check VPC Endpoint (Interface) security group allows their ENIs inbound.
- Check NACLs and any Transit GW route tables — NAT could be hairpinning traffic to link-local if the resolver is misconfigured.
- If corporate WAF/TLS-inspection is in path, ask them to bypass inspection for our FQDN or add SNI passthrough.
infra-bot: [automated] New support ticket created: #SUP-2026 (POC private gateway TLS/DNS). Assigned to jordan-infra.
kevin-sales: Can we also confirm cert chain served by our endpoint is public-trust? The customer reported unfamiliar issuer. alex-eng?
alex-eng: Our endpoint uses a private cert by default in staging. For POCs with private endpoints we often use customer-managed certs or upload a public cert. For staging test we can temporarily enable our public chain. I can toggle and redeploy the endpoint in ~30m.
lisa-ps: Security questionnaire item: customer asked whether we support private endpoints with strict mTLS to customer-managed CAs. We need an answer for sec-qa.
maria-solutions: I'll own the sec-qa reply (can you @alex-eng add the supported mTLS doc link?). Also prepping Dedicated pricing sheet.
kevin-sales: Action list: 1) jordan to validate VPCE SGs/NACLs and route53 associations; 2) alex to switch to public cert on staging endpoint for repro; 3) client to run `dig @their-resolver` and `openssl s_client -servername <our-sni>` and paste output; 4) maria to send Dedicated pricing delta and security answer.
jordan-infra: Started checking VNIs. Found a Transit GW route that was missing for one of their AZs — adding now. Will post results in 10m.
alex-eng: Switched cert chain to public CA on staging and restarted endpoint. Please retest.
kevin-sales: Acme devs re-tested and say TLS handshake progressed further but now see 502 from upstream after a few seconds.
alex-eng: 502 likely from our internal proxy hitting their host headers — posting proxy logs:

```
[2026-03-21T15:22:01Z] proxy_45 - upstream read timeout for req id=abc123
upstream: 10.0.5.23:8080
```

maria-solutions: Thanks — I'm compiling the pricing + sec answers, will DM the contract team if they want Dedicated.
kevin-sales: Great. For the record, customer asked if we can provide a pre-signed route53 record or ephemeral DNS for the POC to avoid their corporate resolver caching issues.
jordan-infra: We can provide a short-lived CNAME that points to the endpoint; but for Private Endpoint integrations it's best they update resolver rules. I'll prepare a small doc on recommended resolver config and send to Acme.
kevin-sales: Cool. If we don't have a blocker after Jordan's TGW fix and Alex's cert change, let's close the swarming thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
